objective:
Built {flyCommerceAdmin}, a companion app that gives FlyCommerce store and marketplace admins everything they need day to day on their phone. For the Dokan plugin, built most of the {dokanVendor} app, where vendors manage their own store, products, orders and everything else that comes with selling. It surpassed $15K in sales within its first few months after launch.

Developed the fully white-label {dokanCustomer} app on a JSON-driven UI, so screens and components can be configured without changing core Flutter code. Also built plugin apps like {flyHR} and {wpProjectManager}, where users connect their WordPress site and start using the app right away.

Worked on real estate and e-commerce apps, building product listings, seller profiles, carts, order management and the rest of the core user flows. Added push notifications and video calling with full CallKit integration, so incoming calls show up like regular phone calls. Built offline-first customer and supplier management on a local database that syncs with the server, which kept the apps usable on weak connections.

Integrated Google Maps and background location tracking for real-time features, including alerts based on user reviews and nearby activity. Built real-time chat over WebSockets that kept messages in sync across users. Worked with the design team to turn mockups into responsive Flutter screens and connected them to the APIs behind them.
